definition: A chemical compound record in the toxicology database, identified by a molecule_id of the form 'TR' plus a zero-padded serial number. It is the unit that carries the carcinogenicity label and that owns atoms and bonds.
name: Molecule
scope: Molecule-level analysis of chemical structure and carcinogenicity in the toxicology database.

definition: The text key molecule_id that uniquely identifies a molecule in the molecule table.
name: Molecule Identifier
scope: Identifying and grouping molecules; the join key between molecule and its atoms and bonds.

definition: The molecule_id value carried on atom and bond records to state which molecule the atom or bond belongs to; it shares the value domain of the molecule table key.
name: Molecule Reference on Child Records
scope: Relating atoms or bonds back to their owning molecule, for example to attach a molecule-level label to a bond or atom.

definition: The molecule-level classification that records whether a molecule is carcinogenic, stored as a single-character code on the molecule record.
name: Carcinogenicity Label
scope: Any question that distinguishes carcinogenic from non-carcinogenic molecules or their constituent atoms, bonds, or elements.

definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity label marks it as carcinogenic.
name: Carcinogenic Molecule
scope: Molecule-scoped filtering in carcinogenicity questions.

definition: A molecule whose carcinogenicity label marks it as not carcinogenic.
name: Non-carcinogenic Molecule
scope: Molecule-scoped filtering in carcinogenicity questions.

definition: A single atom occurrence belonging to exactly one molecule, identified by atom_id and carrying one chemical element symbol.
name: Atom
scope: Atomic composition analysis of molecules in the toxicology database.

definition: The text key atom_id identifying an atom; it is composed of the owning molecule_id, an underscore, and the atom's serial number within that molecule.
name: Atom Identifier
scope: Identifying atoms and resolving atom references that appear inside bond identifiers and in the connectivity relation.

definition: An atom reference recorded as an endpoint of a bond in the atom connectivity relation; it denotes the same atoms as the atom table identifiers.
name: Bond Endpoint Atom Reference
scope: Identifying which two atoms a bond joins, including for bonds named only by their identifier.

definition: The chemical element of an atom, stored as a lowercase element symbol; it is the attribute that describes a molecule's atomic composition.
name: Chemical Element
scope: Element-based filtering and composition analysis of molecules, atoms, and bonds.

definition: A chemical bond belonging to exactly one molecule, identified by bond_id and typed as a single, double, or triple bond.
name: Bond
scope: Bond-level analysis of molecules in the toxicology database.

definition: The text key bond_id identifying a bond; it is composed of the owning molecule_id followed by the serial numbers of the two atoms the bond joins.
name: Bond Identifier
scope: Identifying a bond directly and reading its endpoint atoms out of the identifier.

definition: The bond_id value recorded in the atom connectivity relation to state which bond realizes a connection between two atoms.
name: Bond Reference in Connectivity
scope: Mapping adjacency between atoms back to the bond record that carries the bond type.

definition: The kind of chemical bond joining two atoms: single, double, or triple, stored as a single-character code on the bond record.
name: Bond Type
scope: Filtering and comparing bonds by order within a molecule, a molecule set, or the whole database.

definition: A bond whose bond type code marks it as a single bond; it is one of the three bond order categories.
name: Single Bond
scope: Questions that select or count single bonds, or that restrict a molecule or atom set to molecules containing them.

definition: A bond whose bond type code marks it as a double bond; it is one of the three bond order categories.
name: Double Bond
scope: Questions that select or count double bonds.

definition: A bond whose bond type code marks it as a triple bond; it is one of the three bond order categories and by far the rarest.
name: Triple Bond
scope: Questions that select or count triple bonds, or that restrict a molecule set to molecules containing them.

definition: The relation stating that two atoms are joined by a specific bond. It is recorded once for each direction of the atom pair.
name: Atom Connectivity
scope: Reasoning about which atoms are bonded, how many bonds an atom has, and which atoms a bond connects.

definition: The proportion of molecules that carry the carcinogenic label, relative to all molecules in the stated scope.
name: Carcinogenic Share of Molecules
scope: Molecule-level carcinogenicity prevalence questions.

aliases: number of atoms of an element
definition: The number of distinct atoms carrying a given element symbol within a stated molecule scope, such as all molecules, carcinogenic molecules, or non-carcinogenic molecules.
name: Element Atom Count
scope: Questions asking how many or how numerous atoms of an element are, including most and least numerous element questions.

definition: The number of bonds of each bond type within a stated molecule scope.
name: Bond Type Frequency
scope: Questions about the most or least common bond type, or the count of single, double, and triple bonds.

aliases: share of an element in a molecule
definition: Within a single molecule, the share of its atoms that carry a given element symbol, relative to all atoms of that molecule.
name: Element Ratio within a Molecule
scope: Composition questions about one named molecule.

definition: For a stated set of atoms, the mean number of bonds incident to those atoms.
name: Average Bonds per Atom
scope: Questions asking how many bonds an element's atoms typically have.
